Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BUCKET CAPACITIES FOR MULTI-BUCKET DREDGERS 



1. Scope — Prescribes capacitiBS of the bucket to be used by multi-bucket dredgers for operation in 
rivers, canals, lakes, water-storage, basins, water areas of ports and terminals, etc. 

2. Definition 

2.1 fiucAefCapac/fy — Total volume in cubic metre of liquid contained in the bucket when filled up 
to the upper cutting edges. 

3. Capacities — The bucket capacities ( /) shall be of two series as shown in Table 1. 







TABLE 1 BUCKET CAPACITY, V 












m» 








Series 1 


0*100 


0*160 0*250 0*400 0'630

0-900

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Bucket capacities form the basis for standardization of bucket dredger details. This Indian 
standard IS based on iSO/DIS 7607 ' Shipbnilding — Inland navigation — Multi-bucket dredgers— B 
ucket capacities ', issued by International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ).
